name: kodak-2383-film-look
title_zh: 把一张照片变成严格对齐的 2383 胶片板式海报
tagline_zh: 同一系列多张图，裁切坐标纹丝不动。自带低对比颜料肌理、乳剂溢出与红青错位，像从暗房冲出来的成品，不是滤镜贴纸。
tagline_en: Identical crop coordinates across a series. Built-in pigment grain, emulsion bleed, and red/cyan shift—like a.
desc_en: Turn a user-supplied photograph into a vertical film-board artwork using a strict 1086×1449 locked template: an ungraded upper crop at 810×624 px and a smaller 2383-inspired lower crop at 628×456 px, with identical coordinates across a series. Use an adaptive source-derived board with visible low-contrast brushed/rolled pigment texture, plus irregular emulsion overflow, short red/cyan registration
why_zh: 坐标锁死是硬机制：同一批图自动复用同一套裁切框，系列感来自几何而非手感。颜料纹理取自源图亮度。
why_en: The hard lock on crop coordinates makes series feel systematic, not hand-tuned. Pigment texture derives from source.
limit_zh: 只认 1086×1449 竖版模板，横图或超宽比会被硬裁。纹理是低对比模拟，不追求颗粒级仿真。输入须为单张照片。
limit_en: Only 1086×1449 vertical template; wide images get cropped hard. Texture is low-contrast simulation, not grain-accurate. Single photo in, no.
title_en: Turn one photo into a locked 2383 film-board layout
